statement:
The collection note gives Dane Rusk as the person to collect Leo Barros.
Authorisation recorded: Ana Barros may collect Leo Barros today. Dane Rusk is not permitted.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "Dane Rusk is not permitted" and that he is not on the approved list, giving the correct alternative collector instead.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
